name: Gauntlet
summary: Installs, uses, uninstalls and reinstalls Automaton on your test machines on a schedule and reports failures.
description: Runs test plans over SSH on machines you name: wipe and install Automaton, check the default apps, deploy an app, run a backup, restart, uninstall and install again. Plans that wipe a machine run only on machines marked disposable. Every run and each step's log is kept in the app; a reports page shows history, a Run now button starts a plan and a Home card shows the last result. A failed run sends an email (permission notify:email), asks Claude Code on a machine you choose to diagnose it, and opens one GitHub issue in the right repository; a repeat failure comments on that issue and a later pass comments that it passes again. It never closes an issue.

application.description: Runs install, use, uninstall and reinstall tests on your own machines on a schedule and reports failures by email and GitHub issue.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py gauntlet.py failures.py && pip install --quiet --no-cache-dir --target dist/lib 'paramiko>=3,<5' && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp -r main.py gauntlet.py failures.py index.html gauntlet.js gauntlet.css plans dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: TARGETS
settings.description: The machines to test, as a JSON list of name, host, domain and disposable (see the README). Plans that wipe a machine run only where disposable is true

settings.name: EMAIL_TO
settings.description: Who gets failure emails (needs the notify:email permission approved): administrators, owner, project or an address an administrator allowed; separate several with commas

settings.name: ISSUE_REPOS
settings.description: GitHub repositories a failure may open an issue in, as owner/name separated by commas. Empty: no issues, only emails

settings.name: BOARDS
settings.description: Optional project board per repository, as JSON (see the README). New issues are added to it

settings.name: CLAUDE_TARGET
settings.description: Name of the machine (from TARGETS) where Claude Code is installed and signed in. It diagnoses a failure there, read-only. Empty: issues carry the logs without a diagnosis

settings.name: CLAUDE_COMMAND
settings.description: The command that reads the prompt on standard input and prints one JSON answer on CLAUDE_TARGET

secrets.name: SSH_KEY
secrets.description: Private key (OpenSSH or PEM, no passphrase) that may sign in to every machine in TARGETS. Use a key made for Gauntlet, never the production key

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: A token that may create issues and comments in ISSUE_REPOS (and add to the project boards). Empty: no issues
